title: An independent comultiplication expansion yields a stable coefficient span
statement: Let k be a field and C a k-vector space equipped with a coassociative comultiplication Δ:C→C⊗ₖC and a counit satisfying both counit identities. Let x∈C, let n be a natural number, and let v,w:Fin n→C satisfy that w is k-linearly independent and Δ(x)=Σᵢ vᵢ⊗wᵢ. Then V=spanₖ{vᵢ | i∈Fin n} is finite-dimensional, contains x, and satisfies Δ(y)∈spanₖ{a⊗b | a∈V, b∈C} for every y∈V.
lean_statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {C : Type*} [AddCommGroup C] [Module k C] [Coalgebra k C] (x : C) (n : ℕ) (v w : Fin n → C), LinearIndependent k w → Coalgebra.comul (R := k) x = (∑ i : Fin n, TensorProduct.tmul k (v i) (w i)) → FiniteDimensional k (Submodule.span k (Set.range v)) ∧ x ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range v) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range v), Coalgebra.comul (R := k) y ∈ Submodule.span k {t : TensorProduct k C C | ∃ a ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range v), ∃ b : C, t = TensorProduct.tmul k a b}
